# Gusto MCP connector

Let your AI read your Gusto payroll and HR data: the company, its locations and admins, employees with their jobs and pay rates, contractors, departments, pay schedules and pay periods, processed … The AnythingMCP connector gives Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Cursor and Gemini 25 MCP tools for Gusto: 23 read and 2 can change data.

[![Open Gusto in AnythingMCP Cloud](https://img.shields.io/badge/Open%20in-AnythingMCP%20Cloud-1f6feb?style=for-the-badge)](https://cloud.anythingmcp.com/login?mode=register&redirect=%2Fconnectors%2Fstore%3Finstall%3Dgusto&utm_source=github&utm_medium=catalog&utm_campaign=gusto)

**Category:** [HR](../hr.md) · **Tools:** 25 · **Setup guide:** [anythingmcp.com](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/gusto-to-mcp) · [Deutsch](https://anythingmcp.com/de/guides/gusto-to-mcp) · [Italiano](https://anythingmcp.com/it/guides/gusto-to-mcp) · [Español](https://anythingmcp.com/es/guides/gusto-to-mcp) · [日本語](https://anythingmcp.com/ja/guides/gusto-to-mcp) · [Русский](https://anythingmcp.com/ru/guides/gusto-to-mcp) · [中文](https://anythingmcp.com/zh/guides/gusto-to-mcp)

## Start without code

No installation and no terminal: AnythingMCP Cloud runs the Gusto connector for you, operated by helpcode.ai in Frankfurt, Germany.

1. **Click the button above** and create an account or sign in. The Gusto connector opens, ready to install.
2. **Sign in with your Gusto account** when AnythingMCP asks. The first time, an admin creates a small app in the Gusto developer console. Every click is in the [step-by-step guide](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/gusto-to-mcp).
3. **Click Install.** AnythingMCP shows the address of your MCP server.
4. **Add that address to your assistant:** [Claude](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-gusto-to-claude) · [ChatGPT](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-gusto-to-chatgpt) · [Microsoft Copilot](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-gusto-to-copilot) · [Cursor](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-gusto-to-cursor) · [Gemini CLI](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-gusto-to-gemini) · [Meta Muse](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-gusto-to-muse).
5. **Ask your first question**, for example: *Show Maria Keller's current job title, hourly rate and hire date in Gusto*

Prefer help with the setup? [Talk to us](https://anythingmcp.com/contact).

## How it works

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  client["Claude · ChatGPT · Copilot · Cursor"]
  amcp["AnythingMCP<br/>roles · audit log · encrypted credentials"]
  api["Gusto API"]
  client -- "MCP, OAuth or API key" --> amcp
  amcp -- "HTTPS, an OAuth 2.0 access token, refreshed automatically" --> api
```

- **The AI client** speaks MCP (Streamable HTTP) to AnythingMCP and only sees tool names, descriptions and results. It never gets the Gusto credentials.
- **AnythingMCP** checks the client's role, builds the call from the tool definition, adds the credentials (an OAuth 2.0 access token, refreshed automatically), calls Gusto, logs the call and returns the result.
- **Gusto** sees an ordinary API client with the rights of the account the credentials belong to.

## Tool reference

Every parameter as the AI client sees it in `tools/list`. Source: [`packages/backend/src/adapters/intl/gusto.json`](../../../packages/backend/src/adapters/intl/gusto.json).

### `gusto_get_token_info`

Read what this authorization reaches: resource.type and resource.uuid (the company UUID every company tool needs as company_uuid), resource_owner (the admin who signed in) and scope (the API scopes Gusto granted the application). Call it first.

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /v1/token_info`

No parameters.

### `gusto_get_company`

Read the company: name, trade_name, ein, entity_type, company_status, tier, is_suspended, pay_schedule_type, join_date, funding_type, locations and its compensation types. primary_payroll_admin needs the company_admin:read scope, primary_signatory signatories:read (scope companies:read).

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /v1/companies/{company_uuid}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `company_uuid` | string | yes | The company UUID, resource.uuid from gusto_get_token_info. |

### `gusto_list_locations`

List the company's addresses: street, city, state, zip, phone_number and whether each is a mailing address, filing address or active work location (scope companies:read).

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /v1/companies/{company_uuid}/locations`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `company_uuid` | string | yes | The company UUID, resource.uuid from gusto_get_token_info. |
| `page` | integer | no | Page number, from 1. Without page and per Gusto returns every location. |
| `per` | integer | no | Records per page (Gusto's default is 25). |

### `gusto_list_company_admins`

List the company's Gusto admins with uuid, first_name, last_name and email (scope company_admin:read).

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /v1/companies/{company_uuid}/admins`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `company_uuid` | string | yes | The company UUID, resource.uuid from gusto_get_token_info. |
| `page` | integer | no | Page number, from 1. Without page and per Gusto returns every admin. |
| `per` | integer | no | Records per page (Gusto's default is 25). |

### `gusto_list_employees`

List the company's employees (onboarding, active and terminated) with uuid, name, email, department, onboarding status, terminated, terminations and jobs[] (title, location, hire_date; rate, payment_unit and compensations only with the compensations:read scope). 100 per page by default; the x-total-count header has the total (scope employees:read).

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /v1/companies/{company_uuid}/employees`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `company_uuid` | string | yes | The company UUID, resource.uuid from gusto_get_token_info. |
| `search_term` | string | no | Text to look for in the employees' names. |
| `terminated` | boolean | no | true for employees who left or are scheduled to leave, false for the others. |
| `terminated_today` | boolean | no | true for employees whose termination is in effect today. |
| `onboarded` | boolean | no | true for employees who finished onboarding, false for those still onboarding. |
| `onboarded_active` | boolean | no | true for employees who are onboarded and active today (ready to work). |
| `location_uuid` | string | no | Only employees whose primary work location is this location (uuid from gusto_list_locations). |
| `payroll_uuid` | string | no | Only the employees of this payroll. |
| `sort_by` | string | no | Sort by created_at, name or onboarding_status, optionally with :asc or :desc, e.g. name:desc. Cannot be combined with search_term. |
| `include` | string | no | Extra data, comma separated: all_compensations (needs compensations:read), all_home_addresses, current_home_address, company_name, custom_fields, portal_invitations. |
| `page` | integer | no | Page number, from 1. |
| `per` | integer | no | Employees per page (default 100). |

### `gusto_get_employee`

Read one employee by UUID: name, email, work_email, phone, date_of_birth, title, department, manager_uuid, hired_at, current_employment_status, flsa_status, onboarding status, terminations, eligible paid time off and jobs[] with their job uuids (pay data only with compensations:read) (scope employees:read).

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /v1/employees/{employee_uuid}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `employee_uuid` | string | yes | The employee's uuid from gusto_list_employees. |
| `include` | string | no | Extra data, comma separated: all_compensations, all_home_addresses, current_home_address, company_name, custom_fields, portal_invitations. |

### `gusto_get_employment_history`

Read an employee's employment history: every hire, termination and rehire with its dates and employment status (scope employments:read).

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /v1/employees/{employee_uuid}/employment_history`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `employee_uuid` | string | yes | The employee's uuid from gusto_list_employees. |

### `gusto_list_job_compensations`

List the compensations of one job: rate, payment_unit (Hour, Week, Month, Year, Paycheck), flsa_status and effective_date. By default only the current one; include=all_compensations returns the full pay history (scope compensations:read).

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /v1/jobs/{job_uuid}/compensations`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `job_uuid` | string | yes | The job's uuid, from jobs[] of gusto_get_employee or gusto_list_employees. |
| `include` | `all_compensations` | no | all_compensations for every effective-dated compensation instead of only the current one. |

### `gusto_list_contractors`

List the company's contractors, individual and business, active and inactive: uuid, type, name or business_name, email, wage_type (Fixed or Hourly), hourly_rate, start_date, onboarding status and department. 100 per page by default (scope contractors:read).

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /v1/companies/{company_uuid}/contractors`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `company_uuid` | string | yes | The company UUID, resource.uuid from gusto_get_token_info. |
| `search_term` | string | no | Text to look for in the contractors' names. |
| `terminated` | boolean | no | true for dismissed contractors (or scheduled to be), false for the others. |
| `onboarded` | boolean | no | true for contractors who finished onboarding. |
| `onboarded_active` | boolean | no | true for contractors who are onboarded and active today. |
| `sort_by` | string | no | Sort by created_at, type, onboarding_status or name, optionally with :asc or :desc. |
| `page` | integer | no | Page number, from 1. |
| `per` | integer | no | Contractors per page (default 100). |

### `gusto_get_contractor`

Read one contractor by UUID: type, names or business name, email, wage_type, hourly_rate, start_date, is_active, address and department (scope contractors:read).

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /v1/contractors/{contractor_uuid}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `contractor_uuid` | string | yes | The contractor's uuid from gusto_list_contractors. |

### `gusto_list_departments`

List the company's departments with uuid, title, version and the employees and contractors assigned to each (scope departments:read).

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /v1/companies/{company_uuid}/departments`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `company_uuid` | string | yes | The company UUID, resource.uuid from gusto_get_token_info. |

### `gusto_get_department`

Read one department by UUID: title, its current version (needed by gusto_update_department) and its employees and contractors (scope departments:read).

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /v1/departments/{department_uuid}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `department_uuid` | string | yes | The department's uuid from gusto_list_departments. |

### `gusto_create_department`

Create a department in the company. Every admin sees it in Gusto: confirm the title with the user first. Returns the new department with its uuid and version (scope departments:write).

**Access:** write · **Call:** `POST /v1/companies/{company_uuid}/departments`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `company_uuid` | string | yes | The company UUID, resource.uuid from gusto_get_token_info. |
| `title` | string | yes | Name of the department, e.g. "Customer Success". |

### `gusto_update_department`

Rename a department. Needs the department's current version from gusto_get_department; Gusto answers 409 when someone changed it in the meantime. Confirm with the user first. Installed switched off (scope departments:write).

**Access:** write · **Call:** `PUT /v1/departments/{department_uuid}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `department_uuid` | string | yes | The department's uuid from gusto_list_departments. |
| `title` | string | yes | The new name of the department. |
| `version` | string | yes | The department's current version, from gusto_get_department. |

### `gusto_list_pay_schedules`

List the company's pay schedules: uuid, frequency (Every week, Every other week, Twice per month, Monthly...), anchor_pay_date, anchor_end_of_pay_period, day_1, day_2, name, custom_name, auto_payroll and active (scope pay_schedules:read).

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /v1/companies/{company_uuid}/pay_schedules`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `company_uuid` | string | yes | The company UUID, resource.uuid from gusto_get_token_info. |
| `page` | integer | no | Page number, from 1. Without page and per Gusto returns every pay schedule. |
| `per` | integer | no | Records per page (Gusto's default is 25). |

### `gusto_list_pay_periods`

List pay periods with start_date, end_date, pay_schedule_uuid and the payroll of each (check date, processed or not). Defaults to the last six months; end_date can be at most three months ahead (scope payrolls:read).

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /v1/companies/{company_uuid}/pay_periods`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `company_uuid` | string | yes | The company UUID, resource.uuid from gusto_get_token_info. |
| `start_date` | string | no | First day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: six months ago. |
| `end_date` | string | no | Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, at most three months in the future. Default: today. |
| `payroll_types` | `regular` \| `transition` \| `regular,transition` | no | regular (default), transition, or regular,transition. |

### `gusto_list_payrolls`

List the company's payrolls: payroll_uuid, pay_period, check_date, processed, off_cycle, off_cycle_reason, external and, with include=totals, gross_pay, net_pay, employer_taxes, employee_taxes and company_debit. By default processed regular payrolls of the last six months, 100 per page. Read-only (scope payrolls:read).

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /v1/companies/{company_uuid}/payrolls`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `company_uuid` | string | yes | The company UUID, resource.uuid from gusto_get_token_info. |
| `processing_statuses` | string | no | processed (default), unprocessed, or processed,unprocessed. |
| `payroll_types` | string | no | regular (default), off_cycle, external, comma separated for several, e.g. regular,off_cycle. |
| `start_date` | string | no | Payrolls whose pay period is after this date, YYYY-MM-DD. At most one year before end_date. |
| `end_date` | string | no | Payrolls whose pay period is before this date, YYYY-MM-DD, at most three months ahead. Default: today. |
| `date_filter_by` | `check_date` | no | check_date to filter processed regular payrolls by check date instead of pay period. |
| `include` | string | no | Extra data, comma separated: totals, taxes, payroll_status_meta, risk_blockers, reversals. |
| `sort_order` | `asc` \| `desc` | no | asc (default) or desc, by date. |
| `page` | integer | no | Page number, from 1. |
| `per` | integer | no | Payrolls per page, at most 100 (default 100). The x-total-count header has the total. |

### `gusto_get_payroll`

Read one payroll: pay period, check_date, processed, totals and, once calculated or processed, employee_compensations[] per employee (gross_pay, net_pay, check_amount, fixed and hourly compensations, paid time off, reimbursements; taxes, deductions and benefits with include). Up to 100 employee_compensations per page. Read-only (scope payrolls:read).

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /v1/companies/{company_uuid}/payrolls/{payroll_uuid}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `company_uuid` | string | yes | The company UUID, resource.uuid from gusto_get_token_info. |
| `payroll_uuid` | string | yes | The payroll_uuid from gusto_list_payrolls. |
| `include` | string | no | Extra data, comma separated: benefits (needs the employee_benefits:read scope), deductions, taxes, payroll_taxes, totals, payroll_status_meta, risk_blockers, reversals. |
| `sort_by` | string | no | Order of employee_compensations: first_name or last_name, optionally with :asc or :desc. |
| `page` | integer | no | Page of employee_compensations, from 1. |
| `per` | integer | no | employee_compensations per page, up to 100. |

### `gusto_list_contractor_payments`

List contractor payments between two dates, newest first, with totals: per payment the contractor_uuid, date, wage, hours, bonus, reimbursement, wage_total, payment_method and status. Read-only (scope payrolls:read).

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /v1/companies/{company_uuid}/contractor_payments`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `company_uuid` | string | yes | The company UUID, resource.uuid from gusto_get_token_info. |
| `start_date` | string | yes | First day, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `end_date` | string | yes | Last day, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `contractor_uuid` | string | no | Only the payments of this contractor. |
| `group_by_date` | boolean | no | true to group the payments by check date. |
| `page` | integer | no | Page number, from 1. |
| `per` | integer | no | Payments per page. |

### `gusto_get_contractor_payment`

Read one contractor payment by UUID: contractor_uuid, date, wage, hours, hourly_rate, bonus, reimbursement, wage_total, payment_method, status and may_cancel (scope payrolls:read).

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /v1/companies/{company_uuid}/contractor_payments/{contractor_payment_uuid}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `company_uuid` | string | yes | The company UUID, resource.uuid from gusto_get_token_info. |
| `contractor_payment_uuid` | string | yes | The payment's uuid from gusto_list_contractor_payments. |

### `gusto_list_time_off_policies`

List the company's time off policies (vacation, sick and custom): uuid, name, policy_type, accrual_method, accrual rate and limits, carryover, is_active and the employees on each (scope time_off_policies:read).

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /v1/companies/{company_uuid}/time_off_policies`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `company_uuid` | string | yes | The company UUID, resource.uuid from gusto_get_token_info. |

### `gusto_get_time_off_policy`

Read one time off policy by UUID, with its accrual rules and employees[] carrying each employee's current balance (scope time_off_policies:read).

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /v1/time_off_policies/{time_off_policy_uuid}`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `time_off_policy_uuid` | string | yes | The policy's uuid from gusto_list_time_off_policies. |

### `gusto_list_time_off_requests`

List time off requests of the company, past and future: employee, request_type, policy_type and policy_uuid, status (pending, approved, declined, consumed), days (the hours taken per date), employee_note, employer_note and approver. Narrow it with start_date and/or end_date (scope time_off_requests:read).

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /v1/companies/{company_uuid}/time_off_requests`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `company_uuid` | string | yes | The company UUID, resource.uuid from gusto_get_token_info. |
| `start_date` | string | no | Requests starting on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `end_date` | string | no | Requests ending on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD. |

### `gusto_list_earning_types`

List the company's earning types, split into default (regular wages, overtime, bonus, commission and others with their own tax treatment) and custom, each with uuid, name, category, active and included_in_overtime_pay (scope payrolls:read).

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /v1/companies/{company_uuid}/earning_types`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `company_uuid` | string | yes | The company UUID, resource.uuid from gusto_get_token_info. |

### `gusto_list_company_benefits`

List the benefits the company offers: uuid, benefit_type, description, active, source, partner_name and, with enrollment_count=true, how many employees are enrolled. Health benefits with PHI need the company_benefits:read:phi scope (scope company_benefits:read).

**Access:** read · **Call:** `GET /v1/companies/{company_uuid}/company_benefits`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `company_uuid` | string | yes | The company UUID, resource.uuid from gusto_get_token_info. |
| `active` | boolean | no | true for active benefits only, false for inactive ones. |
| `enrollment_count` | boolean | no | true to add the number of enrolled employees to each benefit. |
| `benefit_type` | string | no | Only these benefit type ids, comma separated, e.g. 5,105. |

## Run it yourself

AnythingMCP is open source (AGPL-3.0). [Run it with Docker](../../../README.md#run-it-yourself), open **Connectors → Store**, pick **Gusto** and enter `GUSTO_CLIENT_ID`, `GUSTO_CLIENT_SECRET`, `GUSTO_API_URL`, then add your MCP server URL to the AI client.
